subject: Re: Scheduling our next call
text:
Hello,

Thank you for your earlier message. I would like to ask, if possible, whether we could move our next call to a slightly later time this week. My current workload has become heavier than expected, and I want to be prepared so that our conversation is useful for both sides.

I understand this may cause inconvenience, and I am happy to adjust to another slot that suits your schedule better. A short change in timing would make a real difference, because several of my course requirements must be submitted at the same point. The tight deadline is not related to any lack of care on my side; it is simply the result of unexpected changes to the seminar reading and a practical task that now has to be completed before our meeting.

If moving the call is not possible, please let me know, and I will do my best to keep the original arrangement. I can join five minutes late only if absolutely necessary, though I would prefer not to miss the opening part. I also noticed the confirmation email lists a short preparation form, which I will finish as soon as I can.

I realize this comes late, and I will avoid requesting further changes after confirming. If there are materials you prefer me to review beforehand, I can send a note about my questions in advance. I hope this does not interrupt your planning for the week too much.

Thank you for considering this request, and apologies for any difficulty it causes. I appreciate your patience and flexibility.

Best regards
